rule.description: A form field shall have a TU key present or all its Widget annotations shall have alternative descriptions (in the form of an Alt entry in the enclosing structure elements)
rule.test: isOutsideCropBox == true || (F & 2) == 2 || (TU != null && TU != '') || (Alt != null && Alt != '')

check.errorMessage: A form field neither has TU key nor its Widget annotations have alternative descriptions (in the form of an Alt entry in the enclosing structure element)

rule.description: An annotation, excluding annotations of subtype Widget, PrinterMark or Link, shall be nested within an Annot tag
rule.test: Subtype == 'Widget' || Subtype == 'PrinterMark' || Subtype == 'Link' || isOutsideCropBox == true || (F & 2) == 2 || structParentStandardType == 'Annot'
